# Homeward — Task Outline

## Replication Notes

- Source: ColorLib Myhome (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/myhome/)
- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/myhome/
- Font: Montserrat (Google Fonts)
- Brand purple: #55407d, accent green: #adc867
- Sections: Header > Hero > Search > Featured > Map > Hot Deal > Testimonials > Footer

## Components to Build

1. HeaderBar — purple top bar with contact info + social
2. Navbar — logo, nav links, submit listing button
3. Hero — full-width property image with title + price overlay
4. SearchBar — "Find your home" with 3 inputs + submit
5. FeaturedProperties — 3-column property card grid
6. MapSection — 7/5 split with location radio list
7. HotDeal — featured property detail with agent info
8. Testimonials — image + quote carousel
9. Footer — 4-column footer + copyright bar

## Delivery contract (repo rules — non-negotiable)

- **Footer credit.** The footer — or, when the design ships no footer, the page's
  last band — SHALL link [Component Dock](https://www.componentdock.com/). That is
  the only attribution line the recreation carries.
- **Source credit is reading, not copy.** Where the research above quotes the
  source's own credit string ("… made with ♥ by …"), it is what the source band
  renders: the recreation replaces it with the Component Dock credit.
- **Provenance ban.** No file under `apps/homeward/` may name the source designer,
  carry a `colorlib.com` URL, or reuse the source template's name — code,
  comments, CSS, markup, metadata and filenames included (AGENTS.md rule 5).
- **Deploy identity.** `apps/homeward/public/CNAME` = `homeward.free.componentdock.com`
  and the package `homepage` = `https://homeward.free.componentdock.com`.
